name: sms
description: IFL Sack Management System — monorepo root

scripts.dev: echo "Run per workspace: 'npm run dev --workspace @sms/web' (Vite on :5173) and 'node api/dist/index.js' after a build. See DEPLOY.md." && exit 0
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b shared sync-worker cli api web
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @sms/shared && npm run build --workspace @sms/sync-worker && npm run build --workspace @sms/cli && npm run build --workspace @sms/api && npm run build --workspace @sms/web
scripts.verify:release: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
